description: Read-only dated change log for the AI assistant and coding-agent plans dataset ("ai-plans" only; other datasets carry a `checked` date but no history yet). Returns `since` (cut-off date), `count`, `changelog` URL and up to 60 `changes`, newest first, each with `date`, `tool`, `tool_id`, `plan`, `field`, `old`, `new`, vendor `source` URL, `method`, `note` and `page`. By default covers the last 30 days and only real moves: price changes, limit changes, plans added or removed. Set `include_wording` to also get re-verification rows where only the vendor wording changed or a value was recorded for the first time. Use it for "what changed in the Claude plans this month" or to check whether a figure from get_tool moved recently.

include_wording.description: Also include re-verification rows that only changed wording or were recorded for the first time.

tool_id.description: Only changes for this product id (as in list_tools, e.g. "claude", "chatgpt", "cursor").

name: list_changes
title: List recent price and limit changes
